surface_name: Claude Code CLI (headless, desktop app, VS Code)
title: Fork subagents now on by default in claude -p, Agent SDK, desktop app and VS Code
symptoms: Headless or SDK runs spawn fork subagents that did not appear before
Subagent calls from a subagent now run in the foreground by default in those surfaces, and the main conversation's subagents always run in the background in desktop and VS Code
cause: Version 2.1.302 turned on fork subagents (subagent_type fork) by default outside the terminal, and changed foreground and background behavior for subagents in desktop and VS Code.
fix: Turn fork subagents off if your workflow depends on the old behavior.
